# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Rogue level 10 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E3/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Rogue
# level-1..level-9 martial-skirmisher baseline to level 10 as chosen input
# only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat) and the deterministic ability/feat/skill
# posture from the level-1..level-9 fixtures, adding only the level bump
# this bounded tranche needs. No rogue-talent choice-slot line is present
# (rogue talents are a level-2+/4+/6+/8+ choice-list feature this tranche
# deliberately does not implement — a genuinely open-ended talent tree, not
# a flat arithmetic burden), so no new choice= line is required beyond the
# level-1..level-9 baseline.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Rogue burden surface: no
# check-execution engine, no trap DC resolution, no magic-trap disarm
# engine, no rogue talent, and no level-11+ progression. The PF1 Core
# Rulebook Rogue class table's level-10 "Special" column reads "Advanced
# talents, rogue talent" (verified independently against d20pfsrd and
# legacy.aonprd.com) — both parts of the same genuinely open-ended
# choice-list feature already deliberately left named-but-unproven at
# levels 2/4/6/8 (the advanced-talent unlock is a list expansion of that
# feature, not a new pillar), so no new pillar is grounded at level 10 —
# only the existing pillars are widened: sneak attack stays 5d6
# ((10 + 1) / 2, the odd-level cadence), Trap Sense stays +3 (10 / 3), and
# Trapfinding genuinely rises to +5 (max(10 / 2, 1)).
case_id=pf1-crb-human-rogue-level10
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:rogue:10
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:17
ability=constitution:12
ability=intelligence:12
ability=wisdom:10
ability=charisma:10
feat=feat:weapon_finesse
skill=skill:stealth:1
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:dexterity
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
